name: contezza
description: Contezza AI - trusted knowledge for AI agents. Plugins for merchants (Verified Answers feed authoring, the commerce-agents adapter quickstart, Contezza's verified MCP layer) and for financial services (cited lending, regulatory and model-risk checks).

plugins.name: contezza-for-merchants
plugins.description: Trusted merchant knowledge for AI agents: policy checks, brand knowledge graphs with citations, and audit-grounded category norms. Author and lint Verified Answers feeds. After adding, open the Connectors tab, select Add, then Connect; no sign-in.

plugins.name: contezza-for-financial-services
plugins.description: Cited lending, regulatory and model-risk checks for Claude: nine read-only tools over public US federal sources and the text or numbers you paste, every answer with citations and effective dates. After adding, open the Connectors tab, select Add, then Connect; no sign-in.
